title: ThO2 lattice parameter + elastic moduli + formation energy

citation.note: Factual crystallographic and elastic-property reference values for thoria (ThO2) in the fluorite structure; non-copyrightable factual data points compiled from widely reported values for the thoria end-member relevant to (Th,U)O2 solid-solution fuels.

values_sources.source_sentence: The lattice parameter of pure ThO2 is 5.5959 angstrom at room temperature.
The theoretical density of ThO2 is 9.7 g/cm^3.
The bulk modulus of ThO2 measured by ultrasonic resonance is 240 GPa at 300 K.
The formation energy of ThO2 from the elements in their standard states is -1226 kJ/mol.
